newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CEEE to auction $186 mln in debentures.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CEEE to auction $186 mln in debentures.

text.p: Rio Grande do Sul state power firm Cia Estadual de Energia Eletrica (CEEE) will auction Thursday 200 million reais ($186 million) in debentures on the Sao Paulo bourse, state officials said.
A state spokeswoman said Rio Grande do Sul has set a 1330 local/1630 gmt auction on the Sao Paulo bourse to sell 40,000 simple debentures each with a nominal value of 5,000 reais.
"The objective is to substitute expired and expiring short-term debt with an average interest rate of 2.60 percent for long-term debt with a projected average rate of 1.79 percent," she said.
Bid specifications published Tuesday said the four-year debentures, which are not convertible to CEEE shares, will have an issue date of March 1, 1997.
The yield will be based on the ANBID reference rate plus a spread of two percent, with the final spread set during the auction, it said.

Interest payments will be made semesterly over the first two years starting in September and amortization and interest rate payments will be made monthly for the last two years from March 1999 to February 2001, it added.
